text.p: Bahrain Telecommunications Company (Batelco) on Wednesday reported a 28.1 million dinar ($74.5 million) net profit for 1996, up 7.6 percent from 26.1 million dinars in 1995.
Last February Batelco had said its 1995 net profit had been 25.8 million dinars.
Wednesday's Batelco statement quoted Chairman Sheikh Ali bin Khalifa al-Khalifa as saying the board would recommend a 29 fils per share dividend for 1996.
He said Batelco planned to cut charges of international calls and leased circuits from March 1, but gave no details.

Batelco, which has one of the most advanced networks in the region, is 39 percent owned by the Bahraini government and 20 percent by Cable and Wireless Plc. The rest is held by investors and financial institutions. ($1 = 0.377 dinar) -- Manama newsroom 973-536187
